name: @pipeworx/mcp-texas-ag-opinions

tools.name: tx_ag_opinion_lookup
tools.description: Look up a Texas Attorney General opinion by its number (e.g. "KP-0537", "GA-0153") -- returns the AG, date, requestor, RQ- request number, topic categories, one-sentence summary, full opinion text, statute citations found in it (best-effort), and whether it has a recorded overruled/modified/affirmed/withdrawn status. Sourced live from texasattorneygeneral.gov/opinions.

opinion_number.description: Opinion number, e.g. "KP-0537", "GA-0153", "DM-212". Case- and spacing-insensitive.

tools.name: tx_ag_opinion_status
tools.description: Check whether a specific Texas AG opinion has a recorded overruled, modified, affirmed, superseded, or withdrawn status in the AG's own courtesy index. A 'not_listed' result does NOT mean the opinion is still good law -- the AG's index itself says it may be incomplete. Sourced from texasattorneygeneral.gov/opinions/opinions-overruled-modified-affirmed-withdrawn.

tools.name: tx_ag_statute_search
tools.description: Find Texas AG opinions interpreting a given statute (e.g. "552.101" (Public Information Act), "551" (Open Meetings Act)) or citing it as a keyword. For Chapter 552/551 citations this returns real opinions (number, date, one-line summary) live from the AG's own topic-category index; other chapters fall back to opinions the AG's RECORDED overruled/modified/affirmed/withdrawn index cites this statute in. PARTIAL CAPABILITY: this is not a full-text search of the whole ~19,000-opinion archive, which needs an authentication this pack does not have -- see the response's coverage_note for exactly what was searched. For a specific opinion's full text, use tx_ag_opinion_lookup.

citation.description: A statute citation or keyword to search for, e.g. "552.101" or "Tex. Gov't Code 2054.5191" or "Open Meetings".

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-texas-ag-opinions forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the texas-ag-opinions pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
